title: Uyarntha Ullam
desc: Anand, a drunkard, gets into a brawl and is saved by Selvam, whom he appoints as his personal assistant. Later, he falls in love with Geetha and decides to transform his lifestyle.

title: Dhinandhorum
desc: A couple decides to get married but faces an obstacle when the girl's father opposes the match.

title: Amaidhi Padai
desc: An ambitious young man uses unscrupulous means to venture into the world of power and politics. However, his illegitimate son vows to bring his father to justice.

title: Veettoda Mappillai
desc: While Kandasamy's two sons-in-law are useless and unemployed, Manikkam, his third son-in-law, helps him improve his hotel business. However, the return of Kandasamy's son causes trouble.

title: Chinna Goundar
desc: Chinna Gounder, a benevolent landlord, tries to prove his innocence after being framed by his brother-in-law, Sakkara Gounder.
